data.narrative:
SirenOpt is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $19.0M to date. The valuation universe comprises nine private peers in the robotics and manufacturing sector, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics, alongside one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ). The narrow peer set limits reliance on median multiples.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable here, using total capital raised as a proxy for entry valuation. Applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed to next-stage progression to the $19M base yields an implied valuation of $48M. The Peer-Median approach is not applicable; while 11 same-sector peers exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier yields insufficient datapoints (fewer than three required for statistical reliability), making an all-sector median misleading and unreliable.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $40M (low) to $55M (high), with a median of $48M. This range reflects primary reliance on the Stage-Progression method given peer set constraints. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight same-stage comparables, limiting ability to cross-validate against market precedent, and sensitivity to the 2.5x multiplier assumption, which varies by investor risk appetite and market conditions. The undisclosed current valuation provides no anchor for calibration.
